subject: Important Update: Your Account Security
body: Dear valued customer, We are writing to inform you about recent security enhancements we have implemented to better protect your account information. As part of our ongoing commitment to safeguard your data, we have upgraded our encryption protocols and added additional security layers to prevent unauthorized access. Please review your account settings and ensure your contact details are up to date. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services. Best regards, The Security Team
